pages.text: On a spring morning, white fog filled the valley. Overnight rain had left the path wet. Even the yard's edge was hidden.
"Grandma, are the yellow flowers blooming by the stream?" "Go and see." Grandma nodded. Yuki tied on a scarf. "I'll see them before the fog clears."
The path ahead was all cloudy white. Yuki lowered their eyes. "If I watch my feet, I won't be scared."
Momo walked close against the stone wall. Watching only their feet, Yuki did not notice.
Grass appeared underfoot. "Why is there grass here?"
Yuki looked up. No wall! White fog everywhere. "Where am I?"
The ground was squishy. Yuki's footprints marked the wet path. Following them one by one, Yuki went back.
Grandma asked, "Where did you look besides your feet?" Yuki shook their head.
Yuki walked with a hand on the stone wall. Its stones felt rough under their fingers. "Momo walked this way, too."
At the wall's end, water babbled. A cluster of yellow flowers bloomed in the fog.
